g.text: 1. saves its screen every 30 s while it changes
2. shutdown: asked to end, saves it once more, ends

text.tspan: 3. starts; its session lists the terminal,

g.text: 5. shows it, a "Restored" line below it

text.tspan: 6. starts a new shell in the saved folder
(at once, or on RET); nothing runs again

g.text: 7. the new prompt, below the old screen
